animations.name: scroll-reveal
animations.description: Elements fade in and translate up (translateY(32px) to none) as they enter the viewport. JS-driven via inline style updates, no @keyframes definition found.

animations.name: testimonial-avatar-spin
animations.description: Continuous 360-degree rotation over 25s for the decorative conic gradient ring around testimonial avatar photos.

animations.name: button-text-translate
animations.description: Button text slides left by 0.5625rem on hover to reveal the arrow icon. Applied to .btn-text elements inside buttons.

animations.name: button-arrow-opacity
animations.description: Arrow icon fades in from opacity 0 to 1 on button hover. Applied to .btn-builtin-icon elements.

animations.name: nav-underline
animations.description: Navigation link underline animates in from translateY(3px) scaleY(0) to translateY(0) scaleY(1) on hover.

animations.name: dropdown-chevron-rotate
animations.description: Dropdown chevron icon rotates 180 degrees when aria-expanded is true.

animations.name: modal-scale-fade
animations.description: Modal dialogs scale from 0.95 to 1 and fade from opacity 0 to 1 when entering, with data-enter/data-leave attributes.

animations.name: global-button-ease
animations.description: Standard easing transition applied to all button background and box-shadow changes on hover/active states.

animations.name: link-arrow-transform
animations.description: Arrow icon on text links translates right by 0.25rem on hover for directional affordance.

animations.name: marquee-scroll
animations.description: Continuous horizontal scroll for the partner logo strip. JS-driven via inline transform: translateX() updates, no CSS @keyframes found.

insights: The design system uses a strict black-and-white button palette with consistent 180ms ease-out transitions, creating a cohesive and predictable interaction language.
CSS variables (--fig-theme-*) provide comprehensive theming support for light/dark modes and component-level color mixing via oklch color space for alpha transparency.

The page heavily relies on JS-driven animations (scroll reveal, marquee) rather than CSS @keyframes, with explicit transition definitions for micro-interactions like button hovers and navigation underlines.
